t: How do I calculate my required minimum distribution?
s: October 22, 2025 - If you own a traditional IRA or have a pretax employer workplace plan like a 401k or 403b, you have until April 1st of the year after you turn 73 to take your first required minimum distribution (RMD). For workplace plans only, if you are still working past age 73 and do not own 5% or more of the business sponsoring the plan, you can delay RMDs from your plan until the year you retire.
